title: Deploying, Operating, and Maintaining AI Systems
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Deploying, Operating, and Maintaining AI Systems and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 15: Deploying, Operating, and Maintaining AI Systems. It lists 9 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 15 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 9 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. Production systems need reproducible releases, performance and cost budgets, monitoring, and a rollback path. Prototype success alone is insufficient. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
